# The editor block (CodeMirror 6): a source file opens in the editor; what's
# typed is unsaved until File ▸ Save writes it; another program's change
# shows up; Markdown opens rendered and its source is the editor.
# (tests/run.sh puts files at @DIR@.)
open:@DIR@/hello.py
editor-wait:go
expect-editor:print("hello")
expect-dirty:no
editor-insert:# from the editor\n
expect-dirty:yes
expect-tab:• hello.py
editor-save:go
expect-dirty:no
expect-file:@DIR@/hello.py=# from the editor
expect-file:@DIR@/hello.py=print("hello")
# Real keys reach the editor too.
type:x = 1
wait:0.5
expect-editor:x = 1
expect-dirty:yes
editor-save:go
expect-file:@DIR@/hello.py=x = 1
# Changed on disk with nothing unsaved here: the editor takes it.
shell:printf 'print("changed elsewhere")\n' > @DIR@/hello.py
wait:1.0
expect-editor:changed elsewhere
expect-dirty:no
# A file at a line.
open:@DIR@/lines.txt:3
editor-wait:go
expect-editor:third
# Windows line ends stay as they were.
open:@DIR@/crlf.txt
editor-wait:go
editor-insert:new-
expect-dirty:yes
editor-save:go
expect-dirty:no
expect-file:@DIR@/crlf.txt=new-one\r\ntwo\r\n
# Markdown: rendered first; edit opens its source in the editor.
edit:@DIR@/notes.md
editor-wait:go
expect-editor:# Notes
shot:editor.png
# Closing with unsaved changes asks: Cancel keeps it, Save writes it first.
open:@DIR@/hello.py
editor-wait:go
editor-insert:unsaved line\n
expect-tab-count:5
key:cmd+w
wait:0.5
expect-sheet:yes
sheet:Cancel
expect-sheet:no
expect-tab-count:5
key:cmd+w
wait:0.5
sheet:Save
wait:0.6
expect-file:@DIR@/hello.py=unsaved line
expect-tab-count:4
# As EDITOR (`libertty +open --wait`): a commit message, which has no
# extension, opens in the editor; closing it tells whoever waits.
wait-edit:T1:@DIR@/COMMIT_EDITMSG
editor-wait:go
editor-insert:Fix the thing\n
key:cmd+w
wait:0.5
sheet:Save
expect-closed:T1
expect-file:@DIR@/COMMIT_EDITMSG=Fix the thing
# Changed on disk while there are unsaved changes here: the editor asks;
# Keep Mine and save writes what's here.
open:@DIR@/lines.txt
editor-wait:go
editor-insert:mine 
shell:printf 'theirs\n' > @DIR@/lines.txt
wait:1.0
expect-page:The file changed on disk.
page-click:Keep Mine
editor-save:go
expect-file:@DIR@/lines.txt=mine 
# Deleted, then back (a branch switch): the text stays and counts as unsaved.
shell:rm @DIR@/lines.txt
wait:1.0
expect-page:isn't on disk
expect-dirty:yes
editor-save:go
expect-file:@DIR@/lines.txt=mine 
# Not UTF-8: read-only, and a save says why rather than mangling it.
open:@DIR@/latin1.txt
editor-wait:go
editor-insert:x
key:cmd+s
wait:0.6
expect-sheet:yes
sheet:OK
expect-shell:od -An -tx1 @DIR@/latin1.txt | tr -d ' \n' ==> 636166e90a
# UTF-16 with its mark stays UTF-16 with its mark.
open:@DIR@/utf16.txt
editor-wait:go
expect-editor:hi
editor-insert:yo 
editor-save:go
expect-shell:od -An -tx1 @DIR@/utf16.txt | tr -d ' \n' ==> fffe79006f0068006900
# UTF-8 with its mark (Windows' editors) keeps the mark.
open:@DIR@/bom.txt
editor-wait:go
expect-editor:hi
editor-insert:yo
editor-save:go
expect-shell:od -An -tx1 @DIR@/bom.txt | tr -d ' \n' ==> efbbbf796f68690a
# A symlink (dotfiles kept elsewhere) opens in the editor and saves through to its file.
open:@DIR@/linked.txt
editor-wait:go
expect-editor:target
editor-insert:via link
editor-save:go
expect-file:@DIR@/target.txt=via linktarget
# Saved and closed as one (vim's :wq): no question about changes already saved.
open:@DIR@/wq.txt
editor-wait:go
editor-insert:wq here
expect-tab-count:9
editor-js:window.webkit.messageHandlers.libertty.postMessage({type: "save", text: libertty.takeText(), close: true})
wait:0.6
expect-sheet:no
expect-file:@DIR@/wq.txt=wq here
expect-tab-count:8
# Rendered Markdown: a table of contents' link scrolls to its heading
# (not Finder, not a tab for the folder), and so does a non-ASCII one.
open:@DIR@/toc.md
page-wait:go
expect-tab-count:9
page-js:window.scrollY ==> 0
page-click:css:a[href="#far-below"]
wait:0.5
page-js:window.scrollY > 500 ==> true
page-js:window.scrollTo(0, 0) || true ==> true
page-click:css:a[href="#café"]
wait:0.5
page-js:window.scrollY > 500 ==> true
expect-tab-count:9
# A shell exiting would close the window with unsaved text in it: it asks.
open:@DIR@/notes.md
editor-insert:more notes
tab:1
type:exit
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect-sheet:yes
sheet:Cancel
expect-sheet:no
